requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Astronomy department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.hint: Mathematics through MATH 216.

requirements.label: Intro Physics: PHYSICS 160/161 or 140/141
requirements.hint: Complete PHYSICS 160 and 161, or PHYSICS 140 and 141.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 160 and 161
requirements.hint: Honors Physics I with Honors Introductory Mechanics Lab.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 140 and 141
requirements.hint: General Physics I with Elementary Laboratory I.

requirements.label: PHYSICS 240 or 260
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: PHYSICS 240 (General Physics II) or PHYSICS 260 (Honors Physics II).

requirements.label: PHYSICS 241 or 261
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: PHYSICS 241 (Elementary Laboratory II) or PHYSICS 261 (Honors Electricity and Magnetism Lab).

requirements.label: PHYSICS 340 or 360
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: PHYSICS 340 (Waves, Heat, and Light) or PHYSICS 360 (Honors Physics III).

requirements.label: PHYSICS 316: Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering
COMPFOR 131 or SI 101
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: COMPFOR 131 (Python Programming for the Sciences) or SI 101 (Introduction to Programming with Python).

requirements.label: Major Requirements: 36 Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from the Astronomy core, Physics core, and Astronomy electives. All required ASTRO courses must be taken in residence; transfer credit is allowed for the required PHYSICS courses.

requirements.label: Astronomy Core: 6 Courses
requirements.hint: ASTRO 201, 361, 399, 402, 404, and 429. Must be taken in residence.

requirements.label: Physics Core: 4 Courses
requirements.hint: PHYSICS 390, 391, 401, and 405. Transfer credit is allowed for these PHYSICS courses.

requirements.label: Astronomy Electives: 2 Courses
requirements.hint: Choose 2 of: ASTRO 401, 403, 405, 406, 416, or 461. By permission of instructor, a 500-level ASTRO course may also count. Must be taken in residence.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits
requirements.hint: minimum 35 credits. Includes all courses used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments (e.g. cognates). Does not include any prerequisites.
